info.name: FinMarket-Enterprise | Phase II Automation & Analytics (M5)
info.description:
Phase II Automation & Analytics (Member 5). Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner (sequential).

BEFORE RUNNING set these collection variables (they come from the Identity, Leads and Campaigns modules):
- advisorToken / advisorUserId - JWT and User _id of advisor A
- otherAdvisorToken / otherAdvisorUserId - JWT and User _id of advisor B
- specialistToken - a marketing specialist with an ACCEPTED relationship to advisor A AND assigned to campaignId
- strangerSpecialistToken - a specialist with no relationship to advisor A
- adminToken - an administrator
- campaignId - an ACTIVE campaign owned by advisor A and assigned to the specialist
- otherAdvisorCampaignId - a campaign owned by advisor B
- badToken stays a made-up string.
Tokens are never stored in this file. The collection is safe to run repeatedly (runTag keeps ids unique). No real email is sent: simulated events never reach Delivery.

item.name: 00 — Setup
item.description: Sets runTag so IDs are unique on every run. Tokens and IDs must be set as collection variables first (see collection description).
